integrity: The interval claim is proved analytically. The bundled checker verifies exact identities and integer inequalities only; numerical diagnostics are not used as proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The result gives a sharp threshold only for one natural diagonal-midpoint/opposite-corner witness. It neither computes the full 3-diameter nor settles constant 3-diameter for the Reuleaux rectangles. An earlier public-posting timestamp for the accepted manuscript was not established.
title: Sharp diagonal-midpoint obstruction in Cassinian Reuleaux rectangles
